title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Record highs on disinflation, but breadth lied. QQQ led, small caps lagged, energy faded despite oil’s drop. PPI’s softness cemented the September-hike cut odds, yet cyclical sectors like XLI and XLB closed negative — this tape is mega-cap tech only.

INDICES — VIX 14.6, below its 16.9 20-day MA. Ranked: QQQ +1.16%, SOXX +0.76%, RSP +0.75%, SPY +0.70%, IJH +0.46%, IJR +0.46%, IWM +0.26%, DIA +0.14%. Large > small by 0.70pp. USO -1.78%, GLD -1.47%. SPY above 200-day.

VOLUME — SPY vol_ratio 0.8x, QQQ 0.8x — both below average, price up on thin volume = low-conviction rally. XLRE 1.1x and XLP 1.0x volume gaining with price up = accumulation in defensives. XLK 0.6x volume with +1.01% = AI bid lacks participation.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLC +2.07%, XLRE +1.42%, XLP +1.08%, XLK +1.01%, XLF +0.59%, XLY +0.48%, XLU +0.46%, XLE +0.05%, XLV -0.04%, XLI -0.05%, XLB -0.51%. Top: DRAM +3.89%, IGV +3.10%; bottom: GDX -2.96%, WGMI -4.00%. Money into comms/software and defensive real estate, out of materials/miners and industrials. Rotation state: broad risk-on.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.98, QQQ 1.12 — QQQ put demand heavy, complacency absent. QQQ skew +4.3% positive, fear priced. SPY at 780.0 vs GEX flip 780.0 — spot pinned to dealer hedging fulcrum, amplifying any move. VIX 14.6 below MA20 = low fear, MOVE 69.2 flat.

CROSS-ASSET — Gold -1.47% while TLT +0.58% — bonds rally on disinflation but metals dump, signaling profit-taking not safe-haven bid. Oil -1.78% on US-Iran demand fears, yet XLE +0.05% — energy stocks refusing to confirm crude’s slide.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Greed 63.1. Movers: WDAY +17.78% on Silver Lake buyout report, PAAS -9.70% no catalyst, INTU +7.04% on lawsuit headline. WDAY 3.7x vol with price up = accumulation. Watch: KWEB -2.51% on 2.1x vol spike (distribution), XLI -0.05% divergence vs SPY, GLD -1.47% breaking trend vs VIX calming.
